title: Future Market
primary_theme: Investing in frontier technologies by projecting future market value
secondary_themes: Network effects in technology-driven business models
founder_lessons: Evaluate market opportunity based on where the market can be, not just where it is today.
First-time founders will make mistakes; the most important signal is whether they learn and iterate.
Defensible technology is only valuable if the team can build the future opportunity and create network economics around it.
Ownership is a proxy; the real focus should be on building something that can generate outsized returns.
notable_quotes: The TAM today might be zero, as it is for let's say quantum computing, but you have to project that forward.
It's the future revenue opportunity times defensibility, which is driven by the technology.
Ownership doesn't really matter. It's just a proxy. It's something we can control.
